title: NASA’s New 3D Model Shows the Earth Is a Lumpy Mess
summary: NASA has released a new geoid model showing the shape of Earth’s gravitational field . NASA created this lumpy version of Earth using models and data from satellites, which can detect minute differences in gravity at different locations.
